senses.definition: To move suddenly, or be excited, on feeling alarm; to start.
To excite by sudden alarm, surprise, or apprehension; to frighten suddenly and not seriously; to alarm; to surprise.
senses.example: The supposition, at least, that angels do sometimes assume bodies need not startle us.

senses.definition: To deter; to cause to deviate.
senses.example: it would blast all their hopes, and startle all other princes from joining

senses.definition: A sudden motion or shock caused by an unexpected alarm, surprise, or apprehension of danger.
senses.example: The figure of a man heaving in sight amidst these wide solitudes, always causes a startle and thrill of expectation and doubt, similar to the feeling produced by the announcement of " a strange sail ahead" on shipboard, during a long voyage.
